subject.title: fix: prevent cumulative usage from inflating session context

question: Should OpenClaw retain the PR's conservative contract that missing exact per-call usage produces an unknown session-context snapshot rather than reusing cumulative billing usage?
rationale: This is an intentional session-state and compaction-policy choice affecting existing cron and embedded-agent reporting paths; source review can establish the implementation, but maintainers must choose the product behavior for incomplete provider telemetry.

options.title: Approve conservative unknown snapshots
options.body: Keep aggregate usage for billing while treating missing exact context snapshots as unavailable, preventing cumulative usage from triggering false compaction.

options.title: Retain an aggregate fallback
options.body: Preserve the former display fallback for incomplete providers, accepting that it may overstate current context and needs an explicit compatibility rationale.

recommendation.title: Approve conservative unknown snapshots
recommendation.body: Keep aggregate usage for billing while treating missing exact context snapshots as unavailable, preventing cumulative usage from triggering false compaction.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged adjacent usage-accounting work is the clearest available history signal for the context-snapshot contract.
